title: Quiet neighbors
question: What happens to a glowing crowd when its signal is quenched?
intervention: Copy the dish at 120 s and add signal quencher (4 per cell) over the patch in copy B only. Run both for 30 seconds and compare how many Lanterns glow and the glow-offs each copy recorded.
predictedTradeoff: Quencher lowers the signal each Lantern senses, so copy B should record more glow-offs and fewer glowing Lanterns; the Lanterns themselves are not harmed, and population loss is not expected within 30 s.
confounds: Quencher spreads out of the patch and fades, and Lanterns keep moving, so the difference can change during the run. A Lantern turns off only after its sensed signal stays low for several seconds. This is one paired run, not proof of a general effect.

all.label: Both copies started from a glowing dish

completion.journalStamp: Compared a glowing crowd with and without quencher
